youtube.title: Why You Get Goosebumps 🥶 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Goosebumps are a leftover from when we had fur. A tiny muscle at the base of every hair pulls it upright when you're cold or scared. On a furry animal, that traps warm air and makes it look bigger. We lost the fur, but the reflex stayed.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
